Class SelfTest

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.client.SelfTest
final class SelfTest extends Object
Checks, in the real game, that the agent's eyes work before any training time is spent: the bot is stood at known spots and the masks must show it where and as large as geometry predicts, and show nothing at all when it is behind the camera.
